description: This file defines the ServiceContainer class, which manages the lifecycle and dispatcher instances for the service engine within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for initialization, starting, stopping, dispatcher management (creation, deregistration, cache handling), and retrieves configuration properties to set up the service environment.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: Manages lifecycle and dispatcher instances for the service engine. Implements the Container interface to initialize, start, stop, and manage LocalDispatcher instances with caching and configuration support.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with configuration and sets up the dispatcher factory based on properties.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service container; currently a stub that returns true.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down jobs and deregisters all dispatchers from cache.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container.

methods.name: getLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves an existing dispatcher from cache or creates a new one, optionally appending tenant ID.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Deregisters a dispatcher by name if it exists.

methods.name: removeFromCache
methods.description: Removes and returns a dispatcher from the cache by name.

methods.name: getAllDispatcherNames
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of all dispatcher names currently cached.
